# Roles and permissions

!!! info "Generated from the code"
    Generated by `scripts/gen_docs.py` — do not edit by hand. Run the script after changing the code.

Roles and their permissions, from `backend/app/security.py` (`ROLE_PERMISSIONS`, `ROLE_DESCRIPTIONS`).

## Roles

| Role | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Administrator | Manages users and settings; can act for any department |
| Hospital director | Dean or hospital director: executive dashboard, sees every department, approves actions, closes discharges |
| Discharge coordinator | Admits patients, approves coordination actions, closes discharges |
| Clinician | Records clinical discharge authorization; completes discharge documents |
| Ward clerk | Admits patients and completes discharge documentation |
| Pharmacy | Prepares discharge medicines and reconciliation |
| Laboratory | Finalizes and gets acknowledgement for lab reports |
| Insurance desk lead | Handles payer authorization; approves insurance actions |
| Billing | Prepares the final bill |
| Auditor | Read-only review of decisions; patient identity masked |
